sentences.zh: 你对原因有什么了解吗？

sentences.en: I was surprised because I had not only spoken with some of these women, but I had also reviewed some of the corroborating evidence, which doesn't always exist in cases like this.
sentences.zh: 我很惊讶，因为我不仅与其中一些女性交谈过，还审查了一些佐证证据，这在类似案件中并不总是存在的。

sentences.en: But in some of these cases, there were messages sent at the time.
sentences.zh: 但在其中一些案件中，当时确实发送过信息。

sentences.en: There were additional witnesses that they had told about the accounts contemporaneously.
sentences.zh: 还有额外的证人，她们在事发当时就向这些人讲述过经过。

sentences.en: So, there was some of that available information for the grand jury to consider.
sentences.zh: 所以，大陪审团确实有一些可供考虑的信息。

sentences.en: But grand jury proceedings are by law secret.
sentences.zh: 但大陪审团的程序在法律上是保密的。

sentences.en: They take place behind closed doors.
sentences.zh: 它们是在闭门会议中进行的。

sentences.en: So, it's hard to know exactly what went on.
sentences.zh: 所以很难确切知道发生了什么。

sentences.en: For Watson's camp, though, this was a major victory.
sentences.zh: 不过对沃森阵营来说，这是一场重大胜利。

sentences.en: Not only does he not have to face criminal charges, but as we know, he's been looking for a new team.
sentences.zh: 他不仅不必面临刑事指控，而且正如我们所知，他一直在寻找新球队。

sentences.en: And essentially, NFL teams see this as a green light to begin a bidding war for his football talents.
sentences.zh: 本质上，NFL球队将此视为开启一场争夺他橄榄球天赋的竞标战的绿灯。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: How much of a bidding war?
sentences.zh: 竞标战有多激烈？

sentences.en: An intense bidding war.
sentences.zh: 一场激烈的竞标战。

sentences.en: Yeah, he's got a market.
sentences.zh: 是的，他很有市场。

sentences.en: We know that.
sentences.zh: 我们都知道这一点。

sentences.en: That's Deshaun Watson.
sentences.zh: 那就是德肖恩·沃森。

sentences.en: Basically, any NFL team that might have been mildly unsatisfied with their quarterback was considering if they should try to pursue Deshaun Watson.
sentences.zh: 基本上，任何可能对自家四分卫感到轻微不满的NFL球队，都在考虑是否应该尝试追求德肖恩·沃森。

sentences.en: I think Deshaun Watson will fit a lot of different places, but I would love to see him go up to Pittsburgh.
sentences.zh: 我认为德肖恩·沃森（Deshaun Watson）适合很多不同的地方，但我很想看到他去匹兹堡。

sentences.en: Carolina, the Saints, and the Washington, of course.
sentences.zh: 当然还有卡罗莱纳、圣徒队和华盛顿队。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: The sports news cycle is trained on Watson, and the only topic of discussion is where he will play next.
sentences.zh: 体育新闻周期聚焦在沃森身上，唯一的讨论话题就是他接下来会去哪里打球。

sentences.en: Because, again, he's a top-five talent in the NFL on the football field.
sentences.zh: 因为再说一次，他在橄榄球场上是NFL前五的天才。

sentences.en: The Saints brass met with Deshaun Watson a second time last night, Wednesday night.
sentences.zh: 圣徒队的高层在昨晚，也就是周三晚上，与德肖恩·沃森进行了第二次会面。

sentences.en: Deshaun Watson would allow the Buccaneers to continue to be a high-end contender immediately.
sentences.zh: 德肖恩·沃森能让海盗队立即继续保持顶级竞争者的地位。

sentences.en: So, there end up being four finalists, the Falcons, the Panthers, the Saints, and the Cleveland Browns.
sentences.zh: 所以，最终有四个决赛入围者：猎鹰队、黑豹队、圣徒队和克利夫兰布朗队。

sentences.en: And Watson begins meeting with these teams in Houston.
sentences.zh: 沃森开始在休斯顿与这些球队会面。

sentences.en: They're recruiting him, tripping over each other to have the opportunity to sign Watson.
sentences.zh: 他们都在招募他，甚至为了有机会签下沃森而争先恐后。

sentences.en: No brainer for Atlanta, in my opinion, to try to do this.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，亚特兰大尝试这样做是理所当然的。

sentences.en: Deshaun Watson in Carolina, to me, would make all the sense in the world.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，德肖恩·沃森去卡罗莱纳再合适不过了。

sentences.en: And then...
sentences.zh: 然后……

sentences.en: Deshaun Watson is expected to be a member of the Cleveland Browns.
sentences.zh: 德肖恩·沃森预计将成为克利夫兰布朗队的一员。

sentences.en: The Browns end up winning this bidding war by offering him an unprecedented contract.
sentences.zh: 布朗队最终通过提供一份史无前例的合同赢得了这场竞标战。

sentences.en: When this trade is completed, Watson is expected to get a five-year, $230 million contract that is fully guaranteed.
sentences.zh: 这笔交易完成后，沃森预计将获得一份为期五年、价值2.3亿美元且全额保障的合同。

sentences.en: That is...
sentences.zh: 那就是……

sentences.en: Guaranteeing him $230 million over five years.
sentences.zh: 保证他在五年内获得2.3亿美元。

sentences.en: His entire contract is fully guaranteed.
sentences.zh: 他的整份合同都是全额保障的。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: $230 million.
sentences.zh: 2.3亿美元。

sentences.en: That is an enormous payday.
sentences.zh: 这是一笔巨额报酬。

sentences.en: It's by far the most guaranteed money ever given to an NFL player.
sentences.zh: 这是迄今为止NFL球员获得的最多的保障金额。

sentences.en: So, these teams, and the Browns who eventually make this winning bid, do not at all seem bothered by the fact that Watson has been facing all these allegations.
sentences.zh: 所以，这些球队，以及最终赢得竞标的布朗队，似乎一点也不受沃森面临的所有这些指控的影响。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: It seemed as though the only thing that mattered to teams was that Watson did not face criminal charges.
sentences.zh: 球队唯一在乎的似乎只是沃森没有面临刑事指控。

sentences.en: But at the same time, there is still the matter of the Browns introducing Deshaun Watson as their next franchise quarterback.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，布朗队将德肖恩·沃森介绍为他们下一任特许经营四分卫的问题依然存在。

sentences.en: And the team certainly understands on some level that there is a public relations problem here.
sentences.zh: 而且球队在某种程度上肯定明白这里存在公关问题。

sentences.en: Good afternoon, everyone.
sentences.zh: 大家下午好。

sentences.en: The press conference that unfolded has to be one of the most bizarre introductory press conferences ever in NFL history.
sentences.zh: 这场新闻发布会一定是NFL历史上最离奇的介绍性新闻发布会之一。

sentences.en: We realize we're not naive to the fact that there are many people who aren't as comfortable with this transaction as we are today.
sentences.zh: 我们意识到，我们并非天真地认为很多人对这笔交易不像我们今天这样感到自在。

sentences.en: But this is something that we, a trade that we made to be evaluated over the long run.
sentences.zh: 但这确实是我们所做的一笔交易，需要从长远来看待。

sentences.en: And we do think that there's a strong and detailed body of work about Deshaun.
sentences.zh: 我们确实认为关于德肖恩有大量详实的工作记录。

sentences.en: And we do have faith in him as a person.
sentences.zh: 我们确实对他作为一个人充满信心。

sentences.en: The team is basically on its heels defending the decision.
sentences.zh: 球队基本上处于守势，在为这个决定辩护。

sentences.en: And the team ultimately can't provide a lot of answers to the questions that reporters are asking.
sentences.zh: 而且球队最终无法对记者提出的问题给出很多答案。

sentences.en: Do you and does this organization believe there was no wrongdoing?
sentences.zh: 你和这个组织是否相信他没有做错任何事？

sentences.en: Notably, Andrew Barry, the Browns general manager, is asked if he and the team believe Watson had committed any wrongdoing.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，布朗队总经理安德鲁·巴里（Andrew Berry）被问及他和球队是否认为沃森有任何不当行为。

sentences.en: We feel very confident in Deshaun the person.
sentences.zh: 我们对德肖恩这个人非常有信心。

sentences.en: And his response was kind of roundabout.
sentences.zh: 他的回答有点绕圈子。

sentences.en: And we believe that as he gets into the community and our organization, he's going to make a positive impact.
sentences.zh: 我们相信，当他融入社区和我们的组织时，他会产生积极的影响。

sentences.en: It was kind of a jarring non-answer, because if you're committing $230 million of guaranteed money to a quarterback,
sentences.zh: 这是一个令人不安的非回答，因为如果你要给一名四分卫投入2.3亿美元的保障金，

sentences.en: shouldn't you be able to answer whether or not he had committed wrongdoing?
sentences.zh: 难道你不应该能够回答他是否做错了事吗？

sentences.en: And they don't.
sentences.zh: 但他们没有。

sentences.en: And they don't.
sentences.zh: 但他们没有。

sentences.en: First, I want to say thank you to Dee and Jim.
sentences.zh: 首先，我要感谢迪（Dee）和吉姆（Jim）。

sentences.en: The other thing that happened in this press conference was it was the first real chance for the media to question Deshaun Watson about the allegations.
sentences.zh: 这场新闻发布会上发生的另一件事是，这是媒体第一次有机会真正就这些指控质询德肖恩·沃森。

sentences.en: Back for Deshaun of this whole off-the-field situation.
sentences.zh: 回到德肖恩场外的整个情况。

sentences.en: Do you have any regrets on anything?
sentences.zh: 你对任何事情有遗憾吗？

sentences.en: And if so, what were them?
sentences.zh: 如果有，是什么？

sentences.en: I mean, I don't have any regrets, because I never did anything that these people are a legend.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我没有任何遗憾，因为我从来没有做过这些人所说的那些事。

sentences.en: He repeated a standard line throughout the course of the press conference, saying over and over again.
sentences.zh: 他在整个新闻发布会过程中重复了一句标准台词，一遍又一遍地说。

sentences.en: I've never assaulted any woman.
sentences.zh: 我从未侵犯过任何女性。

sentences.en: I never disrespected any woman.
sentences.zh: 我从未不尊重过任何女性。

sentences.en: That he had never assaulted any woman.
sentences.zh: 他从未侵犯过任何女性。

sentences.en: He had never disrespected any woman.
sentences.zh: 他从未不尊重过任何女性。

sentences.en: But he was also asked some more specific questions.
sentences.zh: 但他也被问到了一些更具体的问题。

sentences.en: Will you be willing to do things, you know, personally in terms of counseling to show that you'll go the extra mile to make sure nothing like this ever happens again?
sentences.zh: 你是否愿意亲自做一些事情，比如接受心理咨询，以表明你会加倍努力确保此类事情不再发生？

sentences.en: Would he consider seeking counseling?
sentences.zh: 他会考虑寻求心理咨询吗？

sentences.en: And he said...
sentences.zh: 他说……

sentences.en: It's hard for me to say the counseling part, because I don't have a problem.
sentences.zh: 我很难说心理咨询那部分，因为我没有问题。

sentences.en: You know, I don't have an issue.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我没有问题。

sentences.en: That he didn't have a problem, and that's what he'd been saying from the beginning.
sentences.zh: 他没有问题，这就是他从一开始就一直在说的。

sentences.en: He also faced some specific questions about his interactions with massage therapists, including the number of massage therapists that he saw.
sentences.zh: 他还面临一些关于他与按摩师互动的问题，包括他见过的按摩师数量。

sentences.en: Why not just find one you really like and stick with that person?
sentences.zh: 为什么不找一个你真正喜欢的并坚持用那个人呢？

sentences.en: Forty just seems like so many.
sentences.zh: 四十个似乎太多了。

sentences.en: Well, I never, as far as a team, and when I say team, I'm not saying the Cleveland Browns, but my agency and things like that.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我从来没有，就团队而言，当我说是团队时，我不是指克利夫兰布朗队，而是指我的经纪公司之类的地方。

sentences.en: Forty is just over the time.
sentences.zh: 四十个只是随着时间推移积累的。

sentences.en: He kind of downplayed that number, saying that it took place over a longer period of time.
sentences.zh: 他淡化了这个数字，说这是在更长的时间内发生的。

sentences.en: I can't get too far into the details, but, you know, as businesses work and you move and meet different people and people have different schedules and blocks.
sentences.zh: 我不能透露太多细节，但你知道，业务运作时，你会搬家、结识不同的人，人们有不同的日程安排和时间块。

sentences.en: So there were some tough questions in this press conference.
sentences.zh: 所以这场新闻发布会上有一些尖锐的问题。

sentences.en: But there were also a couple of reporters asking football questions.
sentences.zh: 但也有几位记者问了关于橄榄球的问题。

sentences.en: And I have to imagine that the Browns were hoping that would be the focus moving forward.
sentences.zh: 我不得不认为布朗队希望这能成为未来的焦点。

sentences.en: So in spite of everything that has emerged, it's clear that the Browns are moving forward with Watson as their quarterback.
sentences.zh: 所以尽管发生了一切，很明显布朗队正在继续让沃森担任他们的四分卫。

sentences.en: So is that more or less the end of it?
sentences.zh: 所以这差不多就是结束了吗？

sentences.en: Well, there are no criminal charges.
sentences.zh: 嗯，没有刑事指控。

sentences.en: A contract has been signed.
sentences.zh: 合同已经签署。

sentences.en: Deshaun Watson has a new team.
sentences.zh: 德肖恩·沃森有了新球队。

sentences.en: But I really felt like there was more to learn about what happened between Watson and these massage therapists.
sentences.zh: 但我真的觉得关于沃森和这些按摩师之间发生的事情还有更多需要了解的地方。

sentences.en: So, Jenny, when we left off, Deshaun Watson has just signed this historically rich contract.
sentences.zh: 所以，珍妮，当我们上次谈到时，德肖恩·沃森刚刚签下了这份历史性的巨额合同。

sentences.en: And you have decided to dig in and see what else you can uncover about what happened between Watson and these massage therapists who have accused him of misconduct.
sentences.zh: 你决定深入挖掘，看看还能发现什么关于沃森和那些指控他行为不端的按摩师之间发生的事情。

sentences.en: So what did you end up finding?
sentences.zh: 那你最终发现了什么？

sentences.en: Well, I found out a lot that hadn't yet been public.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我发现了很多尚未公开的事情。

sentences.en: You know, the police investigation had taken place behind closed doors.
sentences.zh: 你知道，警方调查是在闭门进行。

sentences.en: But as these civil lawsuits continued to move forward, a lot of information was produced.
sentences.zh: 但随着这些民事诉讼的推进，大量信息被披露出来。

sentences.en: And I also was continuing to talk to different women.
sentences.zh: 我也一直在与不同的女性交谈。

sentences.en: And one of the things I found was that he had worked with far more massage therapists than was previously known.
sentences.zh: 我发现的一件事是，他合作过的按摩师远比之前所知的要多。

sentences.en: He had acknowledged that he'd hired about 40 different therapists.
sentences.zh: 他承认他雇佣了大约40名不同的按摩师。

sentences.en: He said that had taken place across the five seasons he played in Houston.
sentences.zh: 他说这发生在他效力休斯顿的五个赛季里。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But I found in a much narrower period, just from fall 2019 through spring 2021, he had booked appointments with at least 66 different women.
sentences.zh: 但我发现，在一个更短的时间内，即从2019年秋季到2021年春季，他至少预约了66位不同的女性。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And one thing that stood out was not just the number, but he was pretty indiscriminate in who he booked with.
sentences.zh: 有一点很突出，不仅是数量，而且他在预约对象上非常不加选择。

sentences.en: He wasn't asking these women about their experience level, if they had done sports massage before, even whether or not they were licensed.
sentences.zh: 他没有问这些女性的经验水平，她们以前是否做过运动按摩，甚至是否拥有执照。

sentences.en: And he was also pretty persistent in booking these appointments.
sentences.zh: 而且他在预约这些时间时也非常执着。

sentences.en: Some of the evidence that came out in the civil lawsuits were message exchanges with women that he was trying to book massages with.
sentences.zh: 民事诉讼中出现的一些证据是他与试图预约按摩的女性之间的信息交流。

sentences.en: There was this one instance where a massage therapist told him that she was in the middle of moving, and he replied, and you couldn't get away just for an hour from moving?
sentences.zh: 有一次，一位按摩师告诉他她正在搬家，他回复说，你不能从搬家中抽出一个小时吗？

sentences.en: So there really was a sense of urgency in how quickly he wanted to meet up with these women and how often.
sentences.zh: 所以他想见这些女性的紧迫感以及频率确实很高。

sentences.en: In another exchange with the same therapist, he asked her if she had any availability that same day after 4 p.m.
sentences.zh: 在与同一位按摩师的另一次交流中，他问她当天下午4点后是否有空。

sentences.en: She told him, not today, but I can do any time tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 她告诉他，今天不行，但我明天任何时间都可以。

sentences.en: He replied to her, damn, nothing?
sentences.zh: 他回复她，该死，一点时间都没有吗？

sentences.en: You can squeeze in an hour.
sentences.zh: 你可以挤出一个小时。

sentences.en: He also told her later in that same exchange, just trying to support Black businesses.
sentences.zh: 他在同一次交流的后期还告诉她，只是想支持黑人企业。

sentences.en: And this was an approach he used with multiple different women.
sentences.zh: 这是他与多位不同女性使用的方法。

sentences.en: You know, not only were they aware that he was a prominent client who could be good for their business,
sentences.zh: 你知道，她们不仅知道他是一位能给她们业务带来好处的知名客户，

sentences.en: he also was explicitly telling them that he was trying to support their businesses.
sentences.zh: 他还明确告诉她们，他是在试图支持她们的业务。

sentences.en: And I think that really played into the power imbalance that existed here.
sentences.zh: 我认为这确实加剧了这里存在的权力失衡。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: Jenny, I want to just zero in for a moment on the sense of urgency and the indiscriminateness that you just described.
sentences.zh: 珍妮，我想重点谈谈你刚才描述的紧迫感和不加选择性。

sentences.en: Because there's almost something compulsive about this behavior.
sentences.zh: 因为这种行为几乎有一种强迫性。

sentences.en: Watson repeatedly telling therapists, I need a massage, I need it now, make time for me.
sentences.zh: 沃森反复告诉按摩师，我需要按摩，我现在就需要，为我腾出时间。

sentences.en: Why can't you make time for me?
sentences.zh: 你为什么不能为我腾出时间？

sentences.en: What do you make of that?
sentences.zh: 你怎么看？

sentences.en: You know, most professional athletes have a small number of therapists that they work with.
sentences.zh: 你知道，大多数职业运动员合作的按摩师人数很少。

sentences.en: Their body is their business.
sentences.zh: 他们的身体就是他们的事业。

sentences.en: It's vital to their livelihood.
sentences.zh: 这对他们的生计至关重要。

sentences.en: It is vital that they work with people who are highly trained.
sentences.zh: 与训练有素的人合作至关重要。

sentences.en: And so they generally only trust a couple people to work with.
sentences.zh: 所以他们通常只信任几个人来为他们工作。

sentences.en: So Watson's pattern of behavior really stood out as being different.
sentences.zh: 所以沃森的行为模式确实显得与众不同。

sentences.en: It was unusual.
sentences.zh: 这很不寻常。

sentences.en: So what else did you find?
sentences.zh: 那你还发现了什么？

sentences.en: Well, I found out that even before the first lawsuit was filed, a woman he had worked with posted about him on Instagram.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我发现甚至在第一起诉讼提起之前，一位他合作过的女性就在Instagram上发布了关于他的内容。

sentences.en: She shared some of their text messages, their cash app receipts, and she said,
sentences.zh: 她分享了一些他们的短信、Cash App收据，她说，

sentences.en: I could really expose you.
sentences.zh: 我真的可以揭露你。

sentences.en: Watson told the security director for the Texans, who's a former Secret Service agent, about these messages.
sentences.zh: 沃森把这些信息告诉了德州人队的安全主管，他是一位前特勤局特工。

sentences.en: And the security director not only got the post taken down, but he also put a nondisclosure agreement in Watson's locker.
sentences.zh: 安全主管不仅删除了帖子，还在沃森的储物柜里放了一份保密协议（NDA）。

sentences.en: And the idea was that Watson would then bring this NDA to future massage appointments.
sentences.zh: 其想法是沃森随后会将这份保密协议带到未来的按摩预约中。

sentences.en: And in fact, just a couple days later, he started bringing it with him and asked the massage therapist that he was working with to sign the agreement.
sentences.zh: 事实上，仅仅几天后，他就开始随身携带它，并要求他合作的按摩师签署该协议。

sentences.en: Huh.
sentences.zh: 哈。

sentences.en: So this is very intriguing because suddenly it feels like Watson's team is becoming complicit in what he is alleged to be up to here with massage therapists.
sentences.zh: 这非常耐人寻味，因为突然间感觉沃森的团队正在成为他被指控与按摩师所作所为的同谋。

sentences.en: And he's now asking these massage therapists to legally commit to never discussing what happens in these sessions.
sentences.zh: 他现在要求这些按摩师在法律上承诺永远不讨论这些疗程中发生的事情。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And while we don't know exactly what the Texans knew about Watson's massage habit,
sentences.zh: 虽然我们不知道德州人队对沃森的按摩习惯到底了解多少，

sentences.en: I think the NDA is a really good example of how powerful people are often enabled by the institutions around them,
sentences.zh: 但我认为保密协议是一个很好的例子，说明了有权势的人是如何被周围的机构所纵容的，

sentences.en: whether knowingly or not, just based on the resources they have access to.
sentences.zh: 无论是有意还是无意，仅仅是基于他们所能获得的资源。

sentences.en: So Jenny, given everything you're finding and that you're uncovering in real time as a reporter about Watson and these interactions with these therapists,
sentences.zh: 所以珍妮，鉴于你作为一名记者正在实时发现和揭露关于沃森以及他与这些按摩师互动的一切，

sentences.en: I'm curious, are any of these details prompting either police or prosecutors to reconsider the original decision not to bring charges against him?
sentences.zh: 我很好奇，这些细节是否促使警方或检察官重新考虑最初不对他提起指控的决定？

sentences.en: It's always possible that cases can be reconsidered with new evidence.
sentences.zh: 案件总是可能随着新证据的出现而被重新考虑。

sentences.en: But the reality is that for many of these cases, the statute of limitations is running out.
sentences.zh: 但现实情况是，对于其中许多案件，诉讼时效即将到期。

sentences.en: So then I think the focus moves away from the criminal justice system and becomes, will Watson face consequences?
sentences.zh: 所以我认为焦点从刑事司法系统转移开来，变成了沃森会面临后果吗？

sentences.en: And will he face consequences in his sports career from the NFL?
sentences.zh: 他会在NFL的体育生涯中面临后果吗？

sentences.en: And, you know, I think we do start to see a little bit of a shift as these details are made public.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我认为随着这些细节的公开，我们确实开始看到一点转变。

sentences.en: An incredibly eye-opening and stomach-turning report in the New York Times from yesterday, Jenny Varentis.
sentences.zh: 珍妮·瓦伦蒂斯（Jenny Varentis），昨天《纽约时报》的一篇报道令人大开眼界，令人作呕。

sentences.en: The rest of the sports world started to take a greater interest in the allegations themselves.
sentences.zh: 体育界的其他人开始对这些指控本身产生更大的兴趣。

sentences.en: 66 different masseuses in 17 months.
sentences.zh: 17个月内66位不同的按摩师。

sentences.en: Sixty-six.
sentences.zh: 六十六位。

sentences.en: This is a pattern of very disturbing behavior.
sentences.zh: 这是一种非常令人不安的行为模式。

sentences.en: Not just Watson's football career or football future, but the details of the allegations of themselves.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是沃森的橄榄球生涯或橄榄球未来，而是指控本身的细节。

sentences.en: As the evidence mounts, it's now clear that Deshawn was treating all of these women as sex workers.
sentences.zh: 随着证据的增加，现在很清楚德肖恩把所有这些女性都当作性工作者对待。

sentences.en: That's how he went into everyone.
sentences.zh: 他就是这样对待每一个人的。

sentences.en: Why do you need to contact strangers through Instagram?
sentences.zh: 你为什么要通过Instagram联系陌生人？

sentences.en: What's up with that?
sentences.zh: 这是怎么回事？

sentences.en: I think there's a lot of power in the specifics of some of the accounts.
sentences.zh: 我认为这些账户的具体细节非常有说服力。

sentences.en: I think there's a lot of power in reading some of these message exchanges.
sentences.zh: 我认为阅读这些信息交流记录非常有冲击力。

sentences.en: There's been a tendency with this case to kind of talk about the women in aggregate.
sentences.zh: 在这个案件中，人们倾向于把这些女性作为一个整体来谈论。

sentences.en: But when you're forced to consider the specifics of any one account, I think it becomes a lot more real.
sentences.zh: 但当你被迫去审视任何一个具体的账户时，我认为事情就变得真实多了。

sentences.en: And I think that's what happened.
sentences.zh: 我想这就是发生的情况。

sentences.en: We sought to present some of these accounts in a really granular way and force the public to consider the specifics of what these women are alleging happened.
sentences.zh: 我们试图以非常详尽的方式呈现其中一些账户，并迫使公众去审视这些女性所指控的具体内容。

sentences.en: The only thing you can, you can just, by reading all of this, the only word that you come up with is predatory.
sentences.zh: 读完这一切，你唯一能想到的词就是“掠夺性”。

sentences.en: This must be accounted for.
sentences.zh: 这必须得到交代。

sentences.en: And I think pressure built on Watson as a result.
sentences.zh: 我认为沃森因此承受了压力。

sentences.en: And a few things happened.
sentences.zh: 随后发生了一些事情。

sentences.en: One, he settled 20 of the now 24 civil lawsuits against him.
sentences.zh: 第一，在针对他的24起民事诉讼中，他已经与其中20起达成了和解。

sentences.en: He settled 20 of these lawsuits.
sentences.zh: 他与其中的20起诉讼达成了和解。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Just weeks after saying he wasn't thinking about settling, he settles most of the lawsuits.
sentences.zh: 就在他声称没考虑和解的几周后，他就解决了大部分诉讼。

sentences.en: And the other thing that's happening is that there's increasing pressure on the NFL.
sentences.zh: 另一件事是，NFL（美国国家橄榄球联盟）正面临越来越大的压力。

sentences.en: Because throughout all of this, the NFL has been conducting its own investigation of Watson.
sentences.zh: 因为在此期间，NFL一直在对沃森进行自己的调查。

sentences.en: And they're preparing to recommend discipline under the personal conduct policy.
sentences.zh: 他们正准备根据个人行为准则建议进行纪律处分。

sentences.en: And that's happening at this essentially peak of public scrutiny for Watson and his actions.
sentences.zh: 而这正值公众对沃森及其行为的审视达到顶峰之际。

sentences.en: So it's not insignificant that at the point of time in which they're about to recommend discipline, that all of this is going on.
sentences.zh: 所以，在他们即将建议纪律处分的时刻，发生这一切并非无关紧要。

sentences.en: From what you're saying, it's going to be very hard for the NFL to do anything other than issue a meaningful punishment for Watson.
sentences.zh: 照你这么说，NFL除了对沃森进行实质性的惩罚外，很难做出其他选择。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And they have this new collectively bargained process where the initial discipline is issued by a neutral arbiter, jointly appointed by the league and the players association.
sentences.zh: 他们有一套新的集体谈判程序，即初步纪律由联盟和球员工会共同任命的一名中立仲裁员发布。

sentences.en: But the NFL makes a recommendation.
sentences.zh: 但NFL会提出建议。

sentences.en: And the recommendation they make is a very strong one.
sentences.zh: 而且他们提出的建议非常强硬。

sentences.en: They recommend an indefinite suspension for Watson.
sentences.zh: 他们建议对沃森进行无限期停赛。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And that he would have to wait a year to apply for reinstatement.
sentences.zh: 并且他必须等待一年才能申请复出。

sentences.en: That sounds like a meaningful punishment, is it?
sentences.zh: 听起来这是一种实质性的惩罚，是吗？

sentences.en: Well, I think it's always hard to set a number on what's appropriate for alleged misconduct, alleged sexual misconduct.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为对于所谓的行为不端，所谓的性行为不端，要设定一个合适的数字总是很难的。

sentences.en: It's never going to feel great to say this number of games equates to this alleged behavior.
sentences.zh: 说多少场比赛等同于这种所谓的行为，感觉永远不会太好。

sentences.en: But I do think it's a strong message from the NFL that they're taking these allegations seriously, that even though there weren't criminal charges,
sentences.zh: 但我确实认为，这是NFL发出的一个强烈信号，表明他们正在认真对待这些指控，尽管没有刑事指控，

sentences.en: even though his new team signed him to this massive contract,
sentences.zh: 尽管他的新球队与他签下了这份巨额合同，

sentences.en: that they still think that the behavior he is alleged to have engaged in was inappropriate and should keep him off the field for an extended period of time.
sentences.zh: 他们仍然认为他被指控的行为是不恰当的，应该让他长期远离赛场。

sentences.en: About that $230 million, Jenny, if Watson is subjected to this year-long suspension, or maybe even longer, does that have any impact on that money,
sentences.zh: 关于那2.3亿美元，珍妮，如果沃森受到这一年的停赛，甚至更长时间的处罚，这对那笔钱有影响吗，

sentences.en: or will he still be paid that huge guaranteed sum?
sentences.zh: 还是说他依然能拿到那笔巨额的保障金？

sentences.en: It's not uncommon for contracts to have language in them that essentially protects the team from having to pay all of the money to a player in certain circumstances.
sentences.zh: 合同中包含一些条款，在特定情况下保护球队免于支付球员全部薪水，这并不罕见。

sentences.en: We don't know all of those details in this case,
sentences.zh: 我们不知道这个案件中所有这些细节，

sentences.en: but what we do know is that there have been no indications that the Cleveland Browns intend not to pay Deshaun Watson all of his guaranteed money,
sentences.zh: 但我们所知道的是，没有任何迹象表明克利夫兰布朗队打算不支付德肖恩·沃森所有的保障金，

sentences.en: even despite all of the new details that have come out.
sentences.zh: 即使在所有新细节曝光之后也是如此。

sentences.en: So that raises the possibility that Watson will be punished by the NFL and taken off the field, but will still be paid hundreds of millions of dollars.
sentences.zh: 所以这就引出了这种可能性：沃森将受到NFL的惩罚并被禁赛，但仍将获得数亿美元的报酬。

sentences.en: Yes, that's the most likely possibility.
sentences.zh: 是的，这是最有可能的情况。

sentences.en: Jenny, at the end of the day, I'm pretty struck that everything about this story has not played out the way these situations typically do in the Me Too era.
sentences.zh: 珍妮，归根结底，我感到非常震惊的是，这个故事的一切走向与“我也是”（Me Too）时代此类事件的典型发展方式完全不同。

sentences.en: This is an era defined by accusations of sexual misconduct made by women being taken very seriously and triggering, in many cases,
sentences.zh: 这是一个由女性提出的性行为不端指控受到高度重视的时代，在许多情况下，它会引发，

sentences.en: immediate repercussions for the men accused of that misconduct in case after case, in the media, in Hollywood, in the corporate boardroom.
sentences.zh: 对被指控行为不端的男性立即产生反响，无论是在媒体、好莱坞还是企业董事会中，案例比比皆是。

sentences.en: That's not what happened here.
sentences.zh: 但这里发生的情况并非如此。

sentences.en: I mean, here is a powerful man, Deshaun Watson, accused by more than 20 different women of sexual misconduct, yet he remains in his job, he's handsomely paid,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是一个有权势的男人，德肖恩·沃森，被20多名不同的女性指控性行为不端，但他依然保住了工作，薪水丰厚，

sentences.en: all this a year after these allegations were made, and the punishment being contemplated for him in some ways feels like a very well-paid vacation.
sentences.zh: 这一切发生在他被指控一年后，而对他考虑的惩罚在某种程度上感觉就像是一次带薪休假。

sentences.en: So what do you make of all of that, and how do you explain it?
sentences.zh: 那么你对此有何看法，你如何解释这一切？

sentences.en: You know, this story has occupied a lot of my headspace over the last year, and this is something that I have grappled with understanding.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这个故事在过去一年里占据了我很多心思，这是我一直在努力理解的事情。

sentences.en: I think there was almost a perfect storm of factors that undercut our understanding of the Me Too movement.
sentences.zh: 我认为几乎是一场完美的因素风暴削弱了我们对“我也是”运动的理解。

sentences.en: I think the women that were coming forward were largely anonymous women working in a field that is incorrectly conflated with sex work.
sentences.zh: 我认为那些站出来的女性大多是匿名女性，她们从事的领域被错误地与性工作混为一谈。

sentences.en: And I think we sometimes forget that the NFL is not a moral enterprise, that it is a sports league, an entertainment institution, where winning is placed above all else,
sentences.zh: 而且我认为我们有时会忘记，NFL不是一个道德企业，它是一个体育联盟，一个娱乐机构，在那里胜利高于一切，

sentences.en: and that talent will excuse bad behavior.
sentences.zh: 而且天赋会为不良行为开脱。

sentences.en: And in some ways, the way this whole case is played out is really similar to the power imbalance that these women say was present in the massage room with Deshaun Watson.
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上，整个案件的发展方式与这些女性所说的在德肖恩·沃森的按摩室中存在的权力失衡非常相似。

sentences.en: On the one hand, you have a powerful, rich athlete, backed by a powerful, rich sports league.
sentences.zh: 一方面，你有一个强大的、富有的运动员，背后有一个强大的、富有的体育联盟。

sentences.en: And on the other hand, you have people who are often the least listened to in our society.
sentences.zh: 而另一方面，你拥有的是在我们社会中往往最不被倾听的人。

sentences.en: Women, many of them women of color, working in massage therapy, just trying to make a living.
sentences.zh: 女性，其中许多是有色人种女性，从事按摩治疗工作，只是为了谋生。

sentences.en: Well, Jenny, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，珍妮，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们很感激。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你邀请我，迈克尔。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的内容。

sentences.en: The Times reports that over the past few days,
sentences.zh: 《泰晤士报》报道称，在过去几天里，

sentences.en: the Department of Justice has asked witnesses about Donald Trump's involvement in the efforts to overturn the results of the 2020 election,
sentences.zh: 司法部询问了证人关于唐纳德·特朗普在推翻2020年选举结果的努力中所扮演的角色，

sentences.en: suggesting that federal prosecutors are now focusing directly on Trump.
sentences.zh: 这表明联邦检察官现在正直接关注特朗普。

sentences.en: That does not mean that the Justice Department has opened a criminal investigation into the former president, a potentially momentous decision,
sentences.zh: 这并不意味着司法部已经对这位前总统展开了刑事调查，这是一个可能具有重大意义的决定，

sentences.en: but it represents a new and significant phase of the department's investigation of the events around January 6th.
sentences.zh: 但这代表了司法部对1月6日前后事件调查的一个新的重要阶段。

sentences.en: And on Tuesday, the 27 countries of the European Union reached a deal to reduce their use of natural gas in an effort to end their reliance on Russia for energy.
sentences.zh: 周二，欧盟27国达成了一项协议，旨在减少天然气使用，以结束对俄罗斯能源的依赖。

sentences.en: That, in turn, will reduce Russia's ability to retaliate against the EU, as the EU seeks to punish Russia for its invasion of Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 这反过来将削弱俄罗斯对欧盟进行报复的能力，因为欧盟正寻求因俄罗斯入侵乌克兰而对其进行惩罚。

sentences.en: The EU nations have pledged to voluntarily reduce their use of natural gas by 15% by the spring, which will likely require their citizens to use less heat and air conditioning.
sentences.zh: 欧盟国家承诺到春季将天然气使用量自愿减少15%，这很可能要求其公民减少供暖和空调的使用。

sentences.zh: 由约翰·凯彻姆和丽莎·周编辑。

sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.zh: 敬请收听关于如何让客人感到宾至如归的建议。

sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否会昏睡过去。

sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们需要什么样的光线环境？

sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶的人？

sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？
